svg.title: The dashboard in color
svg.desc: The dashboard as a terminal shows it, in the colors proposed: the bar green; the history's bytes a second cyan, above its axis, and its files a second magenta, below; each queue's cells green under half full, yellow to three quarters, red beyond; the bottleneck yellow; a heartbeat that missed one yellow; warnings yellow; the rest as now, its labels dim.

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
g.text: history the last 2 minutes t: the whole transfer
